cohort: 320 neonates with NRDS and 320 matched non-NRDS controls admitted to a neonatal department of a Maternal and Child Health Hospital in South China between January 2015 and December 2017
finding: Maternal age, intrauterine distress, and gestational diabetes were independent risk factors for NRDS, while gestational age was an independent protective factor.
mod_finding: This study found that mode of delivery was a significant factor influencing the risk of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (NRDS) in southern China.
